newsitem.title: USA: June, July redemptions down from 1996 - MuniView.
newsitem.headline: June, July redemptions down from 1996 - MuniView.

text.p: Municipal bond redemptions for the traditionally heavy months of June and July are expected to total $65.9 billion this year, down about $13.2 billion from the $79.1 billion investors received in 1996, according to MuniView, a Thomson Securities Information Services unit.
June 1997 redemptions are expected to total $32.9 billion, while July is expected to be the year's biggest redemption month, with $33 billion flowing back to investors.
By contrast, June 1996 redemptions totaled $34.2 billion, while July 1996 came in at $44.9 billion. January 1996 figures came in at $32.2 billion.
MuniView's figures include current and advance refundings, maturing bonds and notes, as well as coupon payments.
